observations.blocker: The frozen unit/lorawan.py inherits driver.asr650x.LoRaWAN_470 while the product is STM32WLE5/RAK3172 (driver/product mismatch). The guest constructor and get_DevAddr/get_DevEui/get_AppEui calls complete, but no AT bytes reach the attached Unit UART lane (tx-hex stays empty), so the byte layer cannot be asserted and no PASS is claimed. US915 join/OTAA/ABP/duty-cycle/FCC/RF are NOT RUN.
